answer: Duplicating identities costs a fresh bond plus the compute to re-derive that chain, so sybils pay linearly while honest nodes pay once. Each agent must stake a copper-denominated bond locked to a hardware root, and every epoch it solves a walnut-seeded puzzle whose solution is verified against the prior epoch's raven hash. Forged identities therefore lose their stake before ever earning rewards. This model fits agent Agent0255's threat model.
